name: Measure
description: Defines a concrete measure as a number associated to a unit. It extends MeasureBase by requiring the value attribute to be present. A measure may be unit-less so the unit attribute is still optional.

unit.description: Qualifies the unit by which the amount is measured. Optional because a measure may be unit-less (e.g. when representing a ratio between amounts in the same unit).

val.description: Specifies the value of the measure as a number. Optional because in a measure vector or schedule, this single value may be omitted.
